options.name: allow_lowercase
options.description: Allow lowercase letters. Defaults to True.

options.name: allow_symbols
options.description: Allow symbols. Defaults to True. The symbol set is \"!@#$%()+;<>=?[]{}^.,

options.name: allow_uppercase
options.description: Allow uppercase letters. Defaults to True.

options.name: filter_characters
options.description: Character not allowed in the password. Application specific password may not allow certain characters.

options.name: length
options.description: Length of the password. Defaults to 64. The length will be distributes to the allow_* params. For example, the length of 64 will generate 21 lowercase, 21 uppercase, 21 digits, and 21 symbols.
